Adults and children 12 years of age and older: 2 teaspoonfuls (10 mL). Children 6 to under 12 years of age: 1 teaspoonful (5 mL). May be repeated in 4 to 6 hours if required for relief. Not to exceed 4 doses in 24 hours. Children under 6: at discretion of physician.
